opening_complaint: It burns when I urinate and I feel like I need to go every 20 minutes.
full_case_notes: 26-year-old female experiencing 2 days of sharp dysuria, urinary frequency, and urgency. Mild suprapubic discomfort. Denies fever, chills, back pain, flank tenderness, or vaginal discharge. Sexually active, no history of kidney stones.
chief_complaint: It burns when I urinate and I feel like I need to go every 20 minutes.
history_of_present_illness: 26-year-old female experiencing 2 days of sharp dysuria, urinary frequency, and urgency. Mild suprapubic discomfort. Denies fever, chills, back pain, flank tenderness, or vaginal discharge.

opening_complaint: Throbbing headache on the left side of my head with nausea and light sensitivity.
full_case_notes: 32-year-old female with 10-hour history of severe pulsating left-sided headache rated 8/10. Accompanied by nausea, vomiting, photophobia, and phonophobia. Preceded by zig-zag visual spots for 20 minutes. Resting in a dark quiet room helps.
chief_complaint: Throbbing headache on the left side of my head with nausea and light sensitivity.
history_of_present_illness: 32-year-old female with 10-hour history of severe pulsating left-sided headache rated 8/10. Accompanied by nausea, photophobia, and phonophobia.

opening_complaint: Scratchy throat, runny nose, and mild sneezing for the past two days.
full_case_notes: 29-year-old male with 48 hours of clear nasal discharge, sneezing, low-grade temperature (99.2 F), and mild sore throat. No shortness of breath, severe cough, or swollen neck glands. Able to eat and drink normally.
chief_complaint: Scratchy throat, runny nose, and mild sneezing for the past two days.
history_of_present_illness: 29-year-old male with 48 hours of clear nasal discharge, sneezing, low-grade temperature (99.2 F), and mild sore throat.

opening_complaint: Burning feeling in my upper chest after eating spicy dinner, worse when lying down.
full_case_notes: 44-year-old male presenting with painful retrosternal burning sensation occurring 45 minutes after eating a heavy meal. Worsens when reclining in bed or bending over. Temporary relief with chewable antacids. No radiation to arms or jaw, no shortness of breath.
chief_complaint: Burning feeling in my upper chest after eating spicy dinner, worse when lying down.
history_of_present_illness: 44-year-old male presenting with painful retrosternal burning sensation occurring after eating heavy spicy meals. Worsens when reclining.

opening_complaint: Dull band-like pressure squeezing around my entire head after a stressful work week.
full_case_notes: 35-year-old female reporting non-throbbing, constant tight band pressure across forehead and back of neck rated 4/10. No nausea, vomiting, or visual disturbances. Worsens by end of workday after looking at screens.
chief_complaint: Dull band-like pressure squeezing around my entire head after a stressful work week.
history_of_present_illness: 35-year-old female reporting non-throbbing, constant tight band pressure across forehead and neck rated 4/10.

opening_complaint: Itchy watery eyes, frequent sneezing, and clear nasal drip since spring started.
full_case_notes: 24-year-old male experiencing 3 weeks of bilateral eye itching, clear watery nasal drainage, and paroxysmal sneezing outdoors. History of eczema. Denies fever, facial pressure pain, or purulent mucus.
chief_complaint: Itchy watery eyes, frequent sneezing, and clear nasal drip since spring started.
history_of_present_illness: 24-year-old male experiencing 3 weeks of bilateral eye itching, clear watery nasal drainage, and paroxysmal sneezing outdoors.

opening_complaint: Watery diarrhea, abdominal cramping, and mild fever starting last night.
full_case_notes: 21-year-old college student with sudden onset nausea, low-grade fever (100.2 F), diffused abdominal cramping, and 5 episodes of non-bloody watery diarrhea following a catered buffet. Tolerating small sips of electrolyte fluid.
chief_complaint: Watery diarrhea, abdominal cramping, and mild fever starting last night.
history_of_present_illness: 21-year-old student with sudden onset nausea, low-grade fever, diffused abdominal cramping, and 5 episodes of watery diarrhea.

opening_complaint: Sharp lower back pain after lifting heavy moving boxes yesterday.
full_case_notes: 40-year-old male reporting sudden sharp lumbar pain after twisting while lifting a 50 lb box. Pain worsens with bending forward or standing up from a chair. No radiation down legs, no numbness, tingling, or bowel/bladder incontinence.
chief_complaint: Sharp lower back pain after lifting heavy moving boxes yesterday.
history_of_present_illness: 40-year-old male reporting sudden sharp lumbar pain after lifting heavy boxes. Pain worsens with movement. No radiculopathy.

opening_complaint: Tightness in my chest, tingling in my fingers, and feeling like I can't catch a full breath during a panic episode.
full_case_notes: 27-year-old female presenting with acute chest tightness, rapid shallow breathing, finger paresthesia, and feeling of impending doom during a stressful work presentation. Pain is non-radiating, sharp, and improves when breathing into a paper bag. ECG & troponin historically normal.
chief_complaint: Tightness in my chest, tingling in my fingers, and feeling like I can't catch a full breath during a panic episode.
history_of_present_illness: 27-year-old female presenting with acute chest tightness, hyperventilation, and finger tingling during acute emotional stress.

opening_complaint: Deep throbbing right earache and muffled hearing after a cold.
full_case_notes: 8-year-old male (history given by parent) with 2 days of severe right ear pain, temperature 101.4 F, and decreased hearing in right ear following a 5-day cold. Tugging at ear. No drainage from canal.
chief_complaint: Deep throbbing right earache and muffled hearing after a cold.
history_of_present_illness: 8-year-old male with 2 days of severe right ear pain, fever (101.4 F), and decreased hearing following a cold.

opening_complaint: Sharp stabbing heel pain during my very first steps out of bed in the morning.
full_case_notes: 46-year-old female runner with 3-week history of intense focal bottom-of-heel pain upon taking initial morning steps. Pain gradually decreases after walking 10 minutes, but recurs after sitting for long periods.
chief_complaint: Sharp stabbing heel pain during my very first steps out of bed in the morning.
history_of_present_illness: 46-year-old female runner with 3-week history of intense bottom-of-heel pain upon taking initial morning steps.

opening_complaint: Brief spinning sensation whenever I turn my head quickly in bed.
full_case_notes: 61-year-old female reporting 20-second episodes of intense room-spinning vertigo triggered specifically by rolling over to the right in bed or tilting head upward. Accompanied by mild nausea, no hearing loss or tinnitus.
chief_complaint: Brief spinning sensation whenever I turn my head quickly in bed.
history_of_present_illness: 61-year-old female reporting brief 20-second room-spinning vertigo triggered by positional head changes.

opening_complaint: Red itchy rash with small blisters on my forearms after yard work.
full_case_notes: 33-year-old male with linear erythematous pruritc rash and small fluid-filled vesicles on both forearms appearing 24 hours after clearing brush in the woods. Denies fever, swelling of facial lips, or systemic symptoms.
chief_complaint: Red itchy rash with small blisters on my forearms after yard work.
history_of_present_illness: 33-year-old male with linear red itchy rash with small blisters on forearms 24 hours after yard work.

opening_complaint: Recurrent crampy abdominal pain relieved by bowel movements, worse during stress.
full_case_notes: 30-year-old female with 6-month history of lower abdominal cramping, bloating, and alternating bowel habits (loose stools 3-4 times daily during stress). Symptoms temporarily improve following defecation. No weight loss or nocturnal diarrhea.
chief_complaint: Recurrent crampy abdominal pain relieved by bowel movements, worse during stress.
history_of_present_illness: 30-year-old female with 6-month history of lower abdominal cramping, bloating, and loose stools relieved by defecation.

opening_complaint: Gritty, burning sensation in both eyes after working on the computer all day.
full_case_notes: 52-year-old male office worker experiencing bilateral eye scratchiness, dryness, and mild redness by late afternoon. Symptoms improve with over-the-counter lubricating artificial tears. Denies vision changes or discharge.
chief_complaint: Gritty, burning sensation in both eyes after working on the computer all day.
history_of_present_illness: 52-year-old office worker with bilateral eye scratchiness, dryness, and mild redness after prolonged screen use.

opening_complaint: Aching right shoulder pain when reaching overhead or sleeping on my right side.
full_case_notes: 49-year-old male painter reporting 1 month of anterolateral right shoulder ache when lifting arm above 90 degrees or sleeping on right shoulder. Positive painful arc between 60-120 degrees elevation. No acute trauma.
chief_complaint: Aching right shoulder pain when reaching overhead or sleeping on my right side.
history_of_present_illness: 49-year-old male painter reporting 1 month of right shoulder ache when reaching overhead or sleeping on shoulder.

opening_complaint: Twisted my ankle stepping off a curb, mild swelling on the outside ankle.
full_case_notes: 23-year-old female inverted left ankle 4 hours ago. Able to bear weight and walk 4 steps immediately after injury. Mild localized swelling and tenderness over anterior talofibular ligament. No bone tenderness over malleoli.
chief_complaint: Twisted my ankle stepping off a curb, mild swelling on the outside ankle.
history_of_present_illness: 23-year-old female inverted left ankle with mild lateral swelling. Able to bear weight without bony tenderness.

opening_complaint: Lower pelvic cramping and low back ache on the first day of my period.
full_case_notes: 19-year-old female presenting with recurrent midline lower pelvic cramping starting 4 hours before onset of menstrual flow. Accompanied by mild lower back ache and fatigue. Relieved by ibuprofen and heating pad.
chief_complaint: Lower pelvic cramping and low back ache on the first day of my period.
history_of_present_illness: 19-year-old female presenting with recurrent lower pelvic cramping on the first day of menses relieved by NSAIDs.
